Description: Dedicated BlakPath network boundary. Private VPC, private EKS API, no public node or pod IPs, pod security group for Postgres and Redis, required VPC endpoints. Does not create database instances. See docs/adr/0064-isolation-boundary.md.

Assertions.AssertDescription: Deploy this stack only in ap-southeast-2.
